long_biography.plain_text:
Negusneft gave Leonid Lebedev a producing asset at the centre of Sintez. After securing exploration rights in Western Siberia, the company sank new wells, built an oil-processing plant and developed its own infrastructure for industrial trading and exports.

The group had begun in music and video during perestroika, and audio-video sales supplied Lebedev's first substantial business income. He then redirected Sintez into oil trading before building its exploration and production base. The greenfield wells and processing infrastructure turned Sintez from a recording venture into a privately controlled integrated energy business.
